parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time (ISO 8601). Max duration 1 hour (30 minutes in raw mode).

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Attribute key(s) to group results by

parameters.name: aggregate_interval
parameters.description: Aggregation bucket interval. Auto-selected if not specified.

parameters.description: Return raw data points instead of aggregated. Max time range 30 minutes.
